task.title: Stash Changes
task.shortdesc: Shelve your current changes so you can switch context, then bring them back later.

context.p: A stash sets your uncommitted changes aside and returns the working copy to a clean state. Your changes wait in the stash until you apply them again.

step.cmd:
On the
toolbar, open the
drop-down and select Stash changes....

info.p:
To stash only part of your work, select the files in the
or
area, right-click, and select Stash selected files.... Use the Include untracked option to include new files.

step.cmd:
To bring a stash back, open the
drop-down and select List stashes....

info.p: In the stashes dialog box, Apply restores the selected stash, Delete removes it, and Delete all clears every stash. Select Delete stash after being applied to remove a stash automatically once it's applied. Applying a stash can produce conflicts, which you resolve the usual way.
